stem: Which statement about the function \(n(x) = 5x^2 - 20x + 12\) is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The domain of the function is x \geq 2.

options.label: B
options.text: The range of the function is \(n(x) \geq -8\).

options.label: C
options.text: The domain of the function is x \geq 0.

options.label: D
options.text: The range of the function is \(n(x) \leq 12\).
